query: My CASE CX350B was built in 2010. Which lower radiator hose does the catalog show?

The catalog match is the CX350B Tier 3 NA range covering May 2008–November 2018, so it includes your 2010 build but is not serial-specific. [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/cn/6EDA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

query: I need the cab ventilation filter for a 2012 CASE CX210B, not the engine intake filter.
response_text:
The 2012 CASE CX210B catalog shows **two separate cab-filter locations**, both distinct from the engine intake filter:

- **KHR13340 — CAB FILTER**, quantity 1, callout 95 in the air-conditioning ducts assembly. Its observed direct replacement is **47986275**, quantity 1, measuring **235 mm L × 184 mm H × 36 mm W**. Assembly: `https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/chassis-attachments/air-conditioning-ducts/cn/7D00FC71-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/28DA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6`; replacement evidence: `https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/cn/assemblyRemanAltsSubModal?productCode=KHR13340`.
- **KHR13330 — CAB FILTER**, quantity 1, callout 54 in the air-conditioning evaporator assembly. Its observed direct replacement is **48049968**, quantity 1; dimensions were not provided. Assembly: `https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/chassis-attachments/air-conditioning-evaporator/cn/D717F67D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/28DA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6`; replacement evidence: `https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/cn/assemblyRemanAltsSubModal?productCode=KHR13330`.

query: Find the bucket-link spherical bearing for my CASE CX130 built in 2005.

query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
For the US CASE catalog, **two master brake cylinders are listed for a 1985 CASE W20C**, depending on the fitted brake actuator:

- **N9055** — for the **L107985/L112959 Wagner brake actuator**; quantity 1. Product: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/master-cylinder/p/N9055]. Supporting assembly: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].
- **N8695** — for the **L113007 MICO brake actuator**; quantity 1, hydraulic cylinder with a 200 mm stroke. Product: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8695]. Supporting assembly: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6].

The catalog does not establish which actuator is fitted to your machine, and the Wagner replacement direction to L113007 does **not** by itself prove that N9055 and N8695 are interchangeable [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/w20c-brake-system-brake-actuators-to-wheel-cylinders/cn/E9439357-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]. Which actuator or actuator part number is installed?

key_facts: Selected catalog: CASE W20C North America, production range 01/82–12/89. The dated local directory contains 260 assembly titles; inspected occurrence evidence was observed 2026-11-04, but assembly completeness and serial-specific fitment are not established (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/cn/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

Candidate 1 — inspected assembly_ref a165, “7-58 - L107985 AND L112959 BRAKE ACTUATORS”: master cylinder N9055, catalog quantity 1, described as an air-chamber assembly for the brake actuator (Midland N30168). Product: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/master-cylinder/p/N9055. Repair kit N6937, quantity 1, is listed for the master cylinder and includes the specified seal/piston components (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; kit product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/gasket-kit/p/N6937).

Candidate 2 — inspected assembly_ref a166, “7-68 - L113007 BRAKE ACTUATOR”: master cylinder N8695, catalog quantity 1, described as a hydraulic cylinder with 200 mm stroke. Product: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8695. Repair kit N8937, quantity 1, is listed for this master cylinder and includes the stated repair components plus a check valve and seat not used in this actuator (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; kit product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/kit/p/N8937).

Applicability remains unresolved without identifying the actuator fitted to the machine: inspected W20C brake-system assembly_ref a159 lists Wagner actuators L107985/L112959 and MICO L113007, each catalog quantity 2, with no serial restrictions returned. The Wagner actuator rows are marked no longer available and direct the buyer to order L113007, but that replacement direction does not establish interchangeability of master cylinders N9055 and N8695 (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/w20c-brake-system-brake-actuators-to-wheel-cylinders/cn/E9439357-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6).

parent_completions.text:
For the US CASE catalog, **two master brake cylinders are listed for a 1985 CASE W20C**, depending on the fitted brake actuator:

- **N9055** — for the **L107985/L112959 Wagner brake actuator**; quantity 1. Product: [url_3]. Supporting assembly: [url_2].
- **N8695** — for the **L113007 MICO brake actuator**; quantity 1, hydraulic cylinder with a 200 mm stroke. Product: [url_6]. Supporting assembly: [url_5].

The catalog does not establish which actuator is fitted to your machine, and the Wagner replacement direction to L113007 does **not** by itself prove that N9055 and N8695 are interchangeable [url_8]. Which actuator or actuator part number is installed?

query: I have a 2016 CASE SR210. Please identify the right brake pedal pad.
response_text:
The best catalog match for the **right-hand pedal** is:

- **47919765 — PEDAL; RH**
- Quantity: 1
- Callout: 10
- Assembly: **29.200.AN[01] – Pedal Mounting, Foot Controls** ([https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski003s-series/skid-steer-loader-tier-4b/hydrostatic-drive/pedal-mounting-foot-controls/cn/490F45B6-A934-4752-A326-22A966627123/6F7909BA-F6C7-454F-AC12-DF038474C549])
- Product link: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/chassis-frame/fenders-hoods-sheet-metal/pedal/p/47919765]

However, the US catalog entry does **not explicitly identify 47919765 as a brake pedal pad**; it only identifies it as the RH pedal. Therefore, the brake-pad request remains unverified for your 2016 CASE SR210. The evidence comes from a dated SR210 Tier 4B catalog snapshot covering 10/13–01/20.

query: For a 1998 CASE 1840, can you identify the engine oil filter?
